title: Associate Product Manager roadmap
summary: A step-by-step plan to sharpen product discovery, specification, prioritisation, analytics and stakeholder skills, then showcase them in a portfolio and land a role. Each phase builds concrete abilities and deliverables you can add to your résumé.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid grounding in product thinking and core communication tools.

milestones.title: Product Management basics
milestones.outcome: Can explain the product lifecycle and key responsibilities of an APM.

tasks.title: Read product management intro on Coursera
tasks.description: Complete the first two weeks of the free “Product Management Foundations” course to learn the product lifecycle and role expectations.

tasks.title: Watch “how to conduct customer interviews” on YouTube
tasks.description: Take notes on interview techniques and question framing from a reputable product leader video.

tasks.title: Create a 5-minute interview script
tasks.description: Draft a concise script for a hypothetical user interview, focusing on problem discovery.

tasks.title: Practice interview with a peer
tasks.description: Run the script with a friend, record the session, and note areas for improvement.

tasks.title: Reflect on interview insights
tasks.description: Write a short paragraph on what you learned about uncovering user needs.

milestones.title: Writing clear specs
milestones.outcome: Can produce a concise product requirement document (PRD) outline.

tasks.title: Read PRD guide on AIPMM site
tasks.description: Study the free PRD template and guidelines to understand required sections.

tasks.title: Analyse a public PRD example
tasks.description: Download a sample PRD from a tech blog and identify its structure.

tasks.title: Draft a PRD outline for a simple feature
tasks.description: Write headings and bullet points for a feature like “bookmark articles”.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a product forum
tasks.description: Post the outline on a product management subreddit and note suggestions.

tasks.title: Revise PRD outline
tasks.description: Incorporate feedback and produce a cleaned-up version ready for expansion.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop decision-making tools for prioritisation, roadmapping and metrics.

milestones.title: Prioritisation frameworks
milestones.outcome: Can apply at least two frameworks to rank feature ideas.

tasks.title: Read “RICE scoring” article on Intercom blog
tasks.description: Understand the components of Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort and how to calculate scores.

tasks.title: Study “MoSCoW” method on MindTools
tasks.description: Learn how to categorize features into Must, Should, Could, Won’t.

tasks.title: Score three hypothetical features with RICE
tasks.description: Create a spreadsheet, assign values, and compute RICE scores for each feature.

tasks.title: Prioritise same features with MoSCoW
tasks.description: Label each feature using MoSCoW categories and compare outcomes with RICE.

tasks.title: Write a short justification memo
tasks.description: Explain why you chose the final priority order, referencing both frameworks.

milestones.title: Roadmapping Essentials
milestones.outcome: Can design a visual product roadmap for a quarter.

tasks.title: Read Product roadmap guide on Aha! blog
tasks.description: Learn best practices for timeline, themes, and granularity.

tasks.title: Explore free roadmap template on Google slides
tasks.description: Open the template and understand each placeholder.

tasks.title: Create a 3-month roadmap for a news app
tasks.description: Populate the template with epics, features, and milestones.

tasks.title: Share roadmap with a mentor on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Request feedback on clarity and feasibility, note suggestions.

tasks.title: Iterate roadmap based on feedback
tasks.description: Update the visual and add brief success metrics for each item.

milestones.title: Metrics and analytics Foundations
milestones.outcome: Can define success metrics and set up a basic analytics dashboard.

tasks.title: Read “North Star metric” article on Amplitude blog
tasks.description: Understand how to choose a guiding metric for product health.

tasks.title: Watch Google Analytics free course on Skillshop
tasks.description: Complete the introductory module on event tracking.

tasks.title: Define three KPI for a feature launch
tasks.description: Write clear, measurable objectives (e.g., activation rate, retention week-1).

tasks.title: Build a simple dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Connect a sample CSV and visualise the KPIs you defined.

tasks.title: Reflect on metric relevance
tasks.description: Write a brief note on why each KPI matters for product decisions.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Create portfolio pieces that demonstrate your product thinking end-to-end.

milestones.title: Product teardown
milestones.outcome: Can present a critical analysis of an existing product’s strengths and gaps.

tasks.title: Select a popular app to dissect
tasks.description: Choose a widely used mobile app and install the latest version.

tasks.title: Document user flows
tasks.description: Map the primary onboarding and core usage flows with screenshots.

tasks.title: Identify pain points and opportunities
tasks.description: Write a list of three usability issues and three improvement ideas.

tasks.title: Create a 10-slide teardown deck
tasks.description: Combine visuals and notes into a concise presentation.

tasks.title: Publish teardown on Medium
tasks.description: Write a short article linking to the deck and share on social media.

milestones.title: Feature PRD
milestones.outcome: Can deliver a complete product requirement document ready for engineering.

tasks.title: Choose a feature to design
tasks.description: Pick a realistic feature such as “offline reading mode” for a news app.

tasks.title: Conduct quick user survey on Twitter poll
tasks.description: Gather 20+ responses about interest in the feature.

tasks.title: Write full PRD using the template
tasks.description: Fill all sections: problem, goals, user stories, UX mockups, success metrics.

tasks.title: Create low-fidelity wireframes in Figma
tasks.description: Design basic screens to illustrate the feature flow.

tasks.title: Share PRD with a product community for feedback
tasks.description: Post the document on a product forum and note constructive comments.

milestones.title: Metrics plan for launch
milestones.outcome: Can outline a data-driven launch plan with tracking and analysis steps.

tasks.title: Read launch metrics guide on Mixpanel blog
tasks.description: Learn which metrics matter pre-launch, during, and post-launch.

tasks.title: Define launch hypothesis and success criteria
tasks.description: Write a concise hypothesis and three measurable outcomes.

tasks.title: Design event tracking schema in a spreadsheet
tasks.description: List events, parameters, and expected values for the new feature.

tasks.title: Mock-up a launch dashboard in Google data Studio
tasks.description: Create charts for activation, retention, and revenue impact.

tasks.title: Reflect on data-driven decision making
tasks.description: Summarise how the metrics will inform future product iterations.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced habits, network, and prepare for interviews or freelance gigs.

milestones.title: Advanced stakeholder communication
milestones.outcome: Can run effective cross-functional meetings and align stakeholders.

tasks.title: Read “effective Product meetings” on ProductTalk
tasks.description: Identify structures for agenda, decision logs, and follow-ups.

tasks.title: Create a meeting agenda template
tasks.description: Design a reusable agenda with time blocks, objectives, and owners.

tasks.title: Facilitate a mock stakeholder meeting
tasks.description: Invite two peers, run a 30-minute session using the agenda, and record minutes.

tasks.title: Gather feedback on facilitation style
tasks.description: Ask participants to rate clarity and alignment on a short survey.

tasks.title: Refine agenda based on feedback
tasks.description: Update the template to address noted gaps.

milestones.title: Interview & case prep
milestones.outcome: Can confidently answer product interview questions and solve case studies.

tasks.title: Read “Product interview questions” on Glassdoor blog
tasks.description: Familiarise yourself with common APM questions and expected answers.

tasks.title: Practice answering a prioritisation case
tasks.description: Write a structured response to a sample case using RICE, within 15 minutes.

tasks.title: Do a mock interview with a mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a 45-minute video call and receive real-time feedback.

tasks.title: Record and review your answers
tasks.description: Watch the interview recording, note strengths and improvement areas.

tasks.title: Update a one-page interview cheat sheet
tasks.description: Summarise frameworks, metrics, and storytelling tips for quick reference.

milestones.title: Portfolio & personal brand
milestones.outcome: Can present a polished portfolio and LinkedIn profile that attract recruiters.

tasks.title: Design a portfolio website on Carrd
tasks.description: Create a one-page site showcasing the three projects with brief descriptions and links.

tasks.title: Write project case studies
tasks.description: Draft 150-word narratives for each portfolio piece, highlighting problem, solution, and impact.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn headline and summary
tasks.description: Write a headline “Associate Product Manager – Customer-focused, data-driven” and summary

tasks.title: Share portfolio with a senior PM on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Request a short endorsement or feedback on relevance to hiring managers.

tasks.title: Reflect on personal growth
tasks.description: Write a brief blog post summarising what you’ve learned and next career steps.
